release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.43 fixes the remaining Generator stale-pane runtime ordering bug. When the Generator pane already exists before its workspace boot callback runs, Generator now still installs its route wrapper and renders its workspace instead of returning early and leaving the previously selected primary tab visible. Regression coverage verifies Generator becomes the sole active pane when entered from Dashboard, Drops, Tasks, Profiles, Accounts, Proxies, and Settings.
